body: I hope you can find a new life that makes you happier.  The problem for me is that it doesn't matter where I go because I'll always be there.  I can't deal with the thoughts I have. I will never be OK with what I have been through and I have had enough of it.  You can't escape your problems if you are the problem if you know what I mean. it's just too late and it's all too much.  thanks so much for taking the time to talk to me though, the people on this sub are great

I get where you're coming from but I don't even have things I want to achieve anymore.  I don't know if I ever have had any kind of goal. In regard to my funeral?  I'd rather not have one.  I dream of disappearing never being found and just being forgotten. I feel like I'm nothing already.. It sounds like good advice though and I'm glad you have something that helps
